scientific_integrity: The known polytope construction, Gorenstein index and abstract class-group results are credited as prior work; this is a same-model review only.
scientific_limitations: Complex varieties and \(n\ge3\) only; does not classify all singularities or extend to the entire Wu two-parameter family. The global Picard subgroup requires independent mathematical review. The known index and abstract class-group formulas are explicitly credited.
title: Integral Cartier rigidity in the small-alpha toric Fano family
